description: Find health-related associations by pathology or disease. Searches the France Care database for patient associations, support groups, and health advocacy organizations. Supports filtering by pathology (e.g., "cancer", "diabete"), action type, and department. Active associations only, those with a website first.

pathology.description: One of: cancer, handicap, psychiatrie, autisme_tnd, neurologie, cardiologie, pediatrie, rares, respiratoire, addictions, diabete, douleur_palliatif, vision_ophtalmo, perinatalite_gyneco, obesite_nutrition, vih_hepatites, nephrologie, dermato, endometriose, fibromyalgie, allergies, bucco_dentaire, had, chroniques, sante_generale. Common synonyms (alzheimer, diabète, soins palliatifs…) are mapped; an unknown value returns the valid list.

type_action.description: Optional. One of: patients, aidants, sport_loisirs, societe_savante, fonds, evenementiel, tutelle

name: get_health_associations
